overall: The AG found the Commission could no longer rely on the Open Meeting Law to withhold the June 22, 2020 executive session minutes or documents used there, and referred the public records question to the Supervisor of Records; no new order was issued.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission improperly withheld minutes of its June 22, 2020 executive session after the purpose for the session had ended.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission has failed to satisfy its burden of justifying that the purpose for the executive session is ongoing.

allegations.summary: Complainant's records request also covered documents used at the June 22, 2020 executive session, which the Commission was withholding under the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: the Commission may not rely on the Open Meeting Law to withhold either minutes for or documents used at the June 22, 2020, executive session.
